title: Behr Participates in Nationwide Cleanup of Military Cemeteries
summary: During the Masco Month of Service in September, over 60 Behr team members joined thousands of volunteers from across the country on the anniversary of 9/11 for a nationwide beautification of military cemeteries led by Behr’s nonprofit partner Carry The Load. Employees from over a dozen states participated, cleaning headstones at 15 locations spanning from Brooklyn’s Cypress Hills National Cemetery (NY) to San Bruno’s Golden Gate National Cemetery (CA).
